experiments.title: Verification of Thevenin's & Norton's Theorems
experiments.aim: To experimentally determine the Thevenin equivalent voltage (V_th) and equivalent resistance (R_th) of an active linear network.
procedure: 1. Connect the circuit on the breadboard with V_s = 10V, R_1 = 1k, R_2 = 2.2k, R_L = 4.7k.
2. Remove load resistor R_L to measure open-circuit voltage V_oc = V_th across terminals A-B.
3. Deactivate voltage source V_s (short circuit V_s = 0V) and measure equivalent resistance R_th across A-B.
4. Connect equivalent circuit V_th in series with R_th and measure load current I_L.
precautions: Ensure DC power supply is switched OFF while wiring the circuit.
Never measure resistance with power supply connected to avoid DMM fuse blow.
